propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is superseded by per-class environment variables and must be deprecated via _scheduled() with a migration window rather than kept as a permanent alias.

The deprecation warning must be emitted at both env-read sites (config.py:469 and a new read in model_classes.py) to ensure all access paths are covered; placing it only in resolve_model_string would fire falsely for config-table values.

A bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL value, when set and no per-class vars are configured, must map to all three model classes (frontier, planner, reviewer) as the widest-compatibility fallback during the migration window.

Documentation and user-facing strings across six prose files (README.md, five docs/*.md files) must be updated to present class configuration as the current interface, marking REBAR_LLM_MODEL as deprecated.

The deprecation registry entry and all warning emissions must route through the established rebar._deprecations mechanism rather than hand-rolled warnings.warn calls, to remain visible to scripts/gen_env_registry.py and satisfy the test_no_raw_deprecation_emissions enforcement.
